reasons.H1: Pure property of the learning rule; fully settled by simulation.
reasons.H2: A model-identifiability question answerable entirely by simulate-and-refit.
reasons.H3: Normative optimisation over the model's own parameter space; no human data needed.
reasons.H4: Needs human participants: trait compulsivity, subjective confidence and real re-checking behaviour cannot be generated by the model itself.
